description: Small PROVISIONAL Plonkit-sourced claim pack for bollards and road markings. Country sets are intentionally tiny teaching stubs for the observation→claim bridge — not calibrated geography.
alias_notes: Aliases map Detector-shaped observation_type strings onto pack patterns. possible_yellow_marking stays a first-class ROAD_CLAIMS_V1 pattern (not aliased) so yellow road detections do not double-emit with object_road_marking_yellow_center. Generic bollard/road_marking patterns intentionally have empty supports/weakens so unmatched styles emit no country.

claims.notes: PROVISIONAL: generic Detector observation object_bollard / meta_id bollard with no subtype. Empty supports and weakens — unmatched bollard style must not invent a country. Source: Plonk It guide https://www.plonkit.net/guide (bollard metas are country-specific; see Denmark/Finland/Norway/Sweden pages).

PROVISIONAL: white bollard with yellow reflector and a dark orange stripe is described as unique to Denmark on Plonk It Denmark (https://www.plonkit.net/denmark). Small support set for pipeline testing; green variant also noted there. Detector subtype mapping is provisional.

PROVISIONAL / LOW CONFIDENCE: coarse black-and-white roadside bollard family common across Nordic Plonk It pages — Finland long black-and-white with diagonal strip (https://www.plonkit.net/finland), Norway thin curved with reflector in a black parallelogram (https://www.plonkit.net/norway), Sweden black-and-white typically with grey reflector (https://www.plonkit.net/sweden). Does not distinguish FI/NO/SE; prefer country-specific patterns when Detector subtypes exist.

PROVISIONAL: generic Detector observation object_road_marking / meta_id road_marking with no colour/style subtype. Empty supports and weakens — unmatched marking style emits no country. Source: Plonk It guide https://www.plonkit.net/guide (road-line colour and dash style are country-specific).

PROVISIONAL / LOW CONFIDENCE: yellow centre-line style markings are common in North America among other places. Sibling to ROAD_CLAIMS_V1 possible_yellow_marking. Cited from Plonk It Canada (https://www.plonkit.net/canada — single/double yellow centre lines) and the Plonk It guide (https://www.plonkit.net/guide); US coverage similarly uses yellow centre lines. Small support set only; not a worldwide rule (Finland/Norway also document yellow/orange middles).

PROVISIONAL: Norway Plonk It page notes yellow middle lines with a distinct orange tint; Sweden never has yellow middle lines (https://www.plonkit.net/norway, https://www.plonkit.net/sweden). Weakens SE only as a Nordic contrast stub. Detector colour subtype mapping is provisional.
